content.title: About
content.content: Ataulfo mango is a sweet variety with a smooth yellow‑orange flesh, small size and almost no fibrous texture. The fruit is usually harvested ripe, peeled, and served fresh. This cultivar is prized for its honey‑like flavor, creamy texture, and low fiber content, making it ideal for desserts, smoothies, and salads.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Ataulfo originates from Mexico, where it is often called the "king of mangoes".
Unlike many mango varieties, Ataulfo has virtually no fibrous strands, so the flesh cuts easily.
The harvest season runs roughly from March to July in the Northern Hemisphere.
It is sometimes referred to as "honey mango" because of its sweet, honey‑like taste.
Ataulfo mangoes are rich in carotenoids, which give them their bright color.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Mango provides a high amount of vitamin C, supporting immune function and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Source of beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene converts to vitamin A, essential for vision and skin health.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and helps maintain a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Beneficial antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and polyphenols protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to mango, especially those sensitive to latex.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Mango is sweet and contains natural sugars; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Food interactions
items.content: Large amounts of mango may enhance the effects of certain medications, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Peeled Ataulfo mango can be eaten fresh, added to smoothies, fruit salads, yogurts, desserts, and ice cream. It is also used to make purees, sauces, and marinades.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store peeled mango in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 3–5 days. Frozen mango retains flavor and texture for up to 6 months.
